assessment: City-survey property records are confirmed through Gujarat’s official city-survey administration and state property-card service. The property-card workflow is keyed by city-survey/ward/property identifiers and CAPTCHA; no query was submitted and no anonymous parcel geometry was verified.
registryAssessment: Bhavnagar’s official district portal has a Land Records service category. Gujarat Revenue Department’s official IORA service lists Property Cards. Gujarat Informatics Ltd. published a state Settlement Commissioner/Directorate of Land Records procurement document identifying Bhavnagar as one of five city-survey record centers. Together these establish a Bhavnagar city-survey/property-card registry workflow.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Bhavnagar’s official district portal has a Land Records service category. Gujarat Revenue Department’s official IORA service lists Property Cards. Gujarat Informatics Ltd. published a state Settlement Commissioner/Directorate of Land Records procurement document identifying Bhavnagar as one of five city-survey record centers. Together these establish a Bhavnagar city-survey/property-card registry workflow.

The Government of Gujarat Revenue Department advertises view-property-card service. The Bhavnagar district government lists land records, and an official Gujarat Informatics/land-records procurement document names Bhavnagar among city-survey record centers. The state record lookup requires record-location selectors/identifiers and CAPTCHA, so it was not opened/submitted for a parcel. The municipal corporation property-tax portal is also property-account based and was not queried. No geometry-only schema or public parcel-feature service was found.
